verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe OpenHands Cloud as the managed commercial service for running OpenHands without operating your own backend and sandbox infrastructure. The pricing page and GitHub README corroborate hosted cloud access and cloud backends for running agents. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how cloud agents are provisioned and scaled (including parallel runs), independent or hands-on corroboration of the managed service.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a managed cloud offering to run agents without operating my own backend infrastructure

citations.quote: OpenHands Cloud is the managed commercial service for running OpenHands without operating your own backend and sandbox infrastructure.
Hosted cloud access from desktop and mobile
Run OpenHands, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, or any ACP-compatible agent across local, remote, and cloud backends.
